source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI), Adi Parva, adhyaya 2 (Samantapanchaka), vv. 1–9
structure: Every episode: RECAP (≈3 s, not in episode 1; KIT.series.recapStrip) → HOOK (one question; the episode title follows it: KIT.series.episodeTitle) → STORY → NEXT (a cliffhanger line, then the teaser card: KIT.series.nextTeaser).

voice.note: speaker → script/cast.json (voice, speed, pitch). Per line: speed (× the speaker's), pre/post (ms of silence before/after the voice, used by the timeline), say (what is spoken, if not `text`): '…' and '—' pause, ',' and '.' pause a little, [p:400] pauses 400 ms, {s:0.8} speaks what follows at 0.8× until the next {s:…} ({s} resets).

lines.text: In the forest, the sages asked Sauti for the great story.
lines.note: RECAP: episode 1's clearing as a memory (KIT.series.recapStrip)

lines.speaker: elder_sage
lines.text: Tell us, son of the Suta… where was that great war fought?
lines.note: HOOK. beats[0] = 'where': the elder leans in; the episode title shows in the post

lines.speaker: sauti
lines.text: In a sacred land… called Samantapanchaka.
Long before, the warrior-sage Parashurama, axe in hand…
…struck down the warrior kings. Twenty-one times.
With their blood, he filled five great lakes.
His ancestors appeared, and asked him to stop. He did — and the land became holy.
lines.say: His ancestors appeared, and asked him to stop. [p:280] He did — {s:0.86}and the land became holy.

lines.text: On that ground, ages later… eighteen vast armies would meet.
lines.note: NEXT (cliffhanger). beats = 'eighteen' (standards rise on both horizons), 'meet' (a conch)
